caption: Cheerful children's sing-along song for preschool TV in the style of modern nursery-rhyme channels, warm friendly lead vocals with a happy group of cartoon animal voices joining on the chorus, call and response, bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, funky dance groove, playful animal sound effects, catchy repeating chorus, energetic dance party, major key, polished modern kids music production, clear diction, easy for toddlers to sing along
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey hey! It's the Paws and Claws Club!
Stand up! It's time to dance!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Verse]
Rory says shake your head, shake, shake, shake,
Shake it like the jungle is starting to quake!
Shake, shake, one, two, three,
Shake your head along with me!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Verse]
Ziggy says clap your paws, clap, clap, clap,
Clap them up and clap them in your lap!
Clap, clap, one, two, three,
Clap your paws along with me!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Verse]
Waffles says wag your tail, wag, wag, wag,
Wiggle your bottom, zig and zag!
Wag, wag, one, two, three,
Wag your tail along with me!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Verse]
Pebble says stomp your feet, stomp, stomp, stomp,
Stomp them like a penguin, romp, romp, romp!
Stomp, stomp, one, two, three,
Stomp your feet along with me!

[Bridge]
Shake your head! Clap your paws!
Wag your tail! Stomp your feet!
Faster, faster, everybody now,
Freeze! And take a bow!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Chorus]
Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle your body,
Dance like nobody's watching, everybody!
Shake it fast and shake it slow,
Paws and Claws, let's go, go, go!

[Outro]
Great dancing! Bye bye, friends!
